answer: What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The knoll lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pearl is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
